3788.title: Cursor worktree MCP approvals remain bridge-only
3788.rootCauseOneLine: BB seeds only its own MCP bridge approval; project server approvals are neither read nor transferred, and approval fingerprints include the resolved project root.
3788.proposedFix: Define explicit consent or approval-transfer policy before implementing worktree project MCP approval continuity.
3788.caveats: Repeated BB-side unit reproduction only; live Cursor ACP, CLI flags and remote OAuth were not tested. No PR: permission changes are outside simple-fix scope.
